name: What is the typical timeline for kitchen cabinet installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for kitchen cabinet installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for kitchen cabinet installation varies based on the kitchen's size, cabinet type, and any custom modifications. Generally, after the cabinets arrive, the installation process can take anywhere from 3 to 7 business days for standard kitchens. For larger kitchens or those involving complex layouts or custom features, it may extend beyond a week. It's important to have all appliances and countertops ready for precise measurements once the cabinets are in place. We provide a detailed project schedule outlining each phase, allowing you to plan accordingly and understand the expected duration of the work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen cabinet installation typically takes 3 to 7 business days, depending on kitchen size and complexity. Custom projects may take longer.
